sentences.en: The doctor alerted him to the riskiness of the medicine.
sentences.zh: 医生警告他这种药的风险。

sentences.en: I feel more alert after drinking a cup of coffee.
sentences.zh: 喝了一杯咖啡后，我感觉更加警觉了。

sentences.en: My watchdog is alert to the slightest sound and movement.
sentences.zh: 我的看家狗对任何细微的声音和动作都保持警惕。

senses.zh: 警惕的，警觉的；机敏的，敏锐的
